items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Ann Cook, I know Ann Cook when I was running up there around... she lived right around the corner... they all bum-dancing.

ctx.x: Hustlin'. Did they, those women fight with their hands, Rebel? Yeah. Fight just like a man.

Pissed on? Yeah, that's a deed. Then fight with, both ways, with a razor and like, they all had big knives and razor. That's a deed. You getting the best of them, said you grab and take a razor out and slice you up with it. What about Ann Cook, was she? Ann Cook was nervous too. Yeah, she was tough. Mary Jack the Bear and Ann Cook, both of them was. Yeah. Yeah, they were really those.
We don't know too much about Ann Cook. Do you know what, did you know Ann Cook?
